parsed.explanation: The combined operative regime is state-directed targeting of gender-nonconforming people: a capital-bearing sodomy code applied without distinguishing consensual conduct or victim/perpetrator, morality enforcement with documented mass party raids and execution threats (2017), security-force arrest of those suspected of being gay or transgender, summary trials, forced anatomical examinations, documented custodial rape of a trans detainee, official advisories restricting trans presence in public space, and identity documents that disclose trans status. Trans women are conflated with gay men and live-open trans people are judged likely to face persecution by the country's own assessors; convictions are escalated on pretext. No protections, no hate-crime recourse, no anti-discrimination law. A visitor outed faces arrest and detention highly plausibly, with custodial violence documented and capital charging pathways demonstrably in use. This sits at the 0.05-anchor tier, slightly above it only because the most recent documented killing is dated and visitor-specific capital cases are not separately documented.

entry_documents.exposure: Not documented for visitors specifically; the record covers no border, visa, or airport screening of gender presentation.
entry_documents.interaction: Military-style ID cards disclose exemption subsections classifying gay men and trans people as mentally disordered, exposing holders to violence; a visitor issued or checked against similar domestic documents would be durably exposed.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented: raids arresting dozens, indefinite detention without lawyers, detainees threatened with execution, forced anal examinations, custodial rape of a trans activist in an intelligence-ministry facility, summary trials, flogging sentences.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: None documented; appeals and remedies effectively absent.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Trans people suspected of homosexual conduct enter the capital sodomy framework; convictions brought on pretext of more severe charges.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Not documented for visitor-facing facilities (bathrooms, wards, shelters).
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Official advisory warns trans people away from busy public areas — state threat-framing limiting public presence, enforced by security organs nationally.

care_services.exposure: Not documented for visitors; state surgery funding is resident-facing and coercive in character, pressuring binary transition under threat of penalty.
care_services.interaction: Recognition only post-surgery/sterilisation; living openly without recognised surgery is treated as persecution-likely, so an outed non-operative visitor has no compliant status available.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Documented: penal code criminalises same-sex conduct with flogging and death on fourth conviction for some acts; internet monitoring; morality enforcement; clergy split but state recognition used coercively.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: None documented; no anti-discrimination or hate-crime law.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Police, paramilitaries and intelligence ministry act jointly against suspected LGBT people; enforcement national with no documented regional variation.

minors_guardians.exposure: Sodomy capital threshold at 18; foreign-government concern raised about LGBTI minors; a trans minor outed alongside a guardian faces the same arrest, detention and violence regime, with family or guardian unable to intervene against security organs.
minors_guardians.interaction: Family influence is strong and families can be perpetrators (2021 honour-killing pattern); disclosure to family is itself dangerous.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Documented: trans women misgendered and conflated with gay men; security forces harass and arrest; 2021 alleged honour killing of a young gay man; exiled-community survey of systematic persecution driving flight.
street_violence_police_response.protection: None documented; police are perpetrators or hostile bystanders.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Reporting violence risks self-incrimination; victim and perpetrator both criminally liable in assault cases.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Open questions: border treatment of visitors, facility access, entry-document practice — all undocumented; the advisory and activist-letter items are undated in the record.
remedies_unknowns.protection: No non-legislative protection mechanism sourced; exit and exile are the only documented relief routes.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Thin visitor-specific data resolves toward the structural risk: criminalisation, capital charging practice, custodial violence and official hostility imply severe consequences if outed.

anchor_checks.comparison: Very close: temple/morality police detain on discovery of assigned sex, custody produces lethal harm, capital sentence publicly announced as deterrence, no independent advocates. Here the same structure exists — morality enforcement, forced anatomical tests, custodial rape, capital sodomy convictions in use — but the most recent documented killing (2021) is extra-legal rather than a dated state execution, placing it marginally above 0.05.

Substantially worse than 0.25-D: that anchor has entrapment and short sentences with capital punishment not applying. Here executions for homosexual conduct are documented historically, death sentences issued as recently as 2022, custodial violence is severe, and the state explicitly restricts trans public presence — organised targeting, not selective morality policing.

Far below 0.35-B, where detention is hours-long, release without charge typical, and lethal force not credible. Here detention is indefinite, without counsel, with forced examinations, rape documented, and execution threats made to detainees; severity is at the catastrophic tier, not the harassment tier.

parsed.synthesis: The operative regime combines a capital-bearing sexual-conduct code, active morality/security enforcement (documented mass raids with execution threats, internet monitoring, summary trials), and official hostility specific to trans people: public-space advisories, disclosure-bearing documents, coerced binary transition, forced anatomical examinations, and documented custodial rape. Trans women are socially and legally conflated with gay men, placing them inside the sodomy framework's most severe exposure. There are no documented protections at any stage — no anti-discrimination law, no hate-crime recourse, no working remedy, and no visitor-specific exemption documented. A visitor outed faces probable detention with severe documented custodial violence and a credible pathway toward escalated capital-adjacent charges. The absence of documented visitor border incidents does not soften this; the enforcement apparatus is national and indiscriminate. Rating sits at the extreme-risk tier, marginally above 0.05 only because lethal state outcomes documented in the record are dated and the most recent killing documented is non-state.
